verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a framework ecosystem with official tooling can reasonably be expected to give clear dev-server and build errors. The pack only shows page titles, an "Error Reference" and a "Tooling Guide", with no content showing that the dev server or build tool produces clear, actionable messages. The one hands-on report on the topic (vue-comm-16) describes the opposite: going "from one unclear error to another" while configuring build tooling. With no vendor claim of clear build errors to contradict, this is "none" rather than "disputed".
